title: Why Gravity Is A Lie, explained in Zero G
description:
There’s a big problem with gravity… 
Build and learn with KiwiCo! Go to https://www.kiwico.com/cleo and use code CLEO to get 50% off your first month of KiwiCo.

Gravity is a lie. I went into zero gravity to explain why… 

But it won't be easy because gravity is actually one of the most controversial subjects in all of physics. 

This is not some philosophical debate. A huge amount of the tech you use every day depends on our current (limited) understanding of gravity.

If we can understand gravity a little bit better, we can build more things that are huge if true!

So in this video, I joined the European Space Agency on a real zero gravity flight and interviewed theoretical physicists to understand: What really IS gravity? And what are the real life sci-fi ways we might use it in the future?

11:35 What is spacetime?
13:16 Why does this matter?
14:58 Why is gravity fake?
15:48 What are the four fundamental forces?
16:50 Quantum mechanics v gravity
17:55 The theory of everything!
18:51 AdS/CFT
20:10 What if we could change gravity?
21:50 Something you might love

Bio:
Cleo Abram is an Emmy-nominated independent video journalist. On her show, Huge If True, Cleo explores complex technology topics with rigor and optimism, helping her audience understand the world around them and see positive futures they can help build. Before going independent, Cleo was a video producer for Vox. She wrote and directed the Coding and Diamonds episodes of Vox’s Netflix show, Explained. She produced videos for Vox’s popular YouTube channel, was the host and senior producer of Vox’s first ever daily show, Answered, and was co-host and producer of Vox’s YouTube Originals show, Glad You Asked.
